name: thread-keeper
description: Keep conversation threads straight: branch a point into a capsule file another session can continue, merge results back, and show the current position.

interface.shortDescription: Branch, merge, and track conversation threads across sessions.
interface.longDescription: Thread Keeper keeps the main line of a long conversation intact. Branch any point into a small capsule file that another pane, session, or agent can continue from; merge the result back with one word; and see the main position, open branches, and parked questions at a glance.
